params.rebalance: monthly, overlapping cohorts, 1/K of the book replaced each month

testable_here: Y: perp daily closes
note: Measures whether assets with the highest compounded 3-12 month return beat those with the lowest over the next 3-12 months, as an equal-weighted decile spread.

params.weighting: linear: w_i = -(r_i - r_ew) / sum of positive deviations

testable_here: Y: 1m-1d klines; skip-bar variant trivial
note: Measures whether last week's relative losers beat last week's relative winners over the next week, with weights proportional to each asset's deviation from the equal-weighted market.

params.lag_signs: negative at lag 1, positive at lag 12
params.quantiles: deciles on the forecast, extreme-decile spread

testable_here: Y: monthly returns from daily klines; exact regression specification not read
note: Underlying primitive P3 with P1 (1-month reversal plus 12-month continuation): sorts assets on a regression forecast of next-month return built from their own past monthly returns and measures the extreme-decile spread.

params.factor_model: Fama-French RMRF, SMB, HML (alpha excluded from residual)
params.regression_window: months t-36 to t-1, full 36 required
params.score: sum of residuals over score window divided by their standard deviation over the same window

testable_here: Y: only with an unpublished crypto market factor (BTC or an index) in place of FF3, no HML
note: Measures whether assets with the highest volatility-scaled factor-hedged (residual) return over months t-12 to t-2 beat those with the lowest over the next 1-12 months.

params.grouping: 2-digit SIC, 20 industries (V25; not confirmed for MG99)

testable_here: Partial: needs a coin-to-sector map (none in archive; a hand-built map risks lookahead)
note: Measures whether the sectors with the best 6-month return beat the sectors with the worst over the next 6 months.

params.score: P(t-1) / highest price of the prior 52 weeks

testable_here: Y: highs from klines; needs a year of listing
note: Measures whether assets trading closest to their 52-week high beat those furthest from it over the next 6 months.

params.vol_window: 1 year of daily log returns, at least 120 days
params.corr_window: 5 years of overlapping 3-day log returns, at least 750 days
params.split: median beta, weights by distance from mean rank

testable_here: Y: beta against BTC or an index; the 5-year correlation window exceeds most perp histories
note: Measures whether beta-levered low-beta assets beat beta-delevered high-beta assets over the next month.

testable_here: Y: residuals against a crypto market factor in place of FF3
note: Measures whether assets with the lowest daily residual volatility over the past month beat those with the highest over the next month.

params.score: mean of the N largest daily returns in month t-1

testable_here: Y: 1d klines; intraday-max variants unpublished
note: Measures whether assets whose largest daily returns last month were smallest beat those whose largest daily returns were biggest over the next month.

params.quantiles: deciles, long lowest skew, short highest

testable_here: Y: 1m klines give weekly realized moments; source sampling interval unknown
note: Measures whether assets with the lowest realized skewness of intraday returns this week beat those with the highest over the next week.

params.measure: yearly mean of |daily return| / daily dollar volume (x10^6), divided by that year's cross-sectional mean (ILLIQMA)
params.filters: more than 200 days of data, price above $5, top and bottom 1% of ILLIQ dropped
params.published_test: monthly Fama-MacBeth regressions of year-y returns on year y-1 ILLIQMA with controls; a sort is an adaptation

testable_here: Y: |r| / quote volume from klines; perps span a narrow liquidity range
note: Measures whether assets that were more illiquid last year (price impact per dollar traded) earn higher returns through the following year.

params.measure: market-average Amihud ILLIQ, split into expected and unexpected parts

testable_here: Y: market ILLIQ from klines quote volume; expectation model and horizon not in card
note: Measures whether higher expected market-wide illiquidity predicts higher subsequent market excess return (the card adds that unexpected illiquidity lowers prices at the time it happens).

params.legs: n smallest long, n largest short

testable_here: Partial: no market cap or supply data; volume and OI measure liquidity, not size
note: Measures whether the n smallest assets by market value beat the n largest on a beta-adjusted basis.

params.factor: mean of 3 small portfolios minus mean of 3 big portfolios

testable_here: N: needs book-to-market and quality data, which exist for equities only
note: Measures the small-minus-big spread from a size by book-to-market sort, with and without a control for firm quality.

params.quantiles: 30/40/30 top minus bottom (factor); quintiles Q5-Q1 (single characteristic)

testable_here: Y: perp daily closes; perp list far narrower than the source universe
note: Measures whether coins with the highest past 1-4 week return beat those with the lowest over the next week.

params.measure: log market cap at the end of the formation week

testable_here: Partial: no market cap in archive
note: Measures whether the smallest coins by market cap beat the largest over the next week.

testable_here: Y: quote volume from klines; volume window not stated in card
note: Measures whether the coins with the lowest dollar trading volume beat those with the highest over the next week.

params.score: sum of log weekly returns, winsorized at 1000%
params.split: Large&Liquid = previous-week cap >= $50M and weekly volume >= $5M, else Small/Illiquid
params.sign_by_group: Large&Liquid long Q5 short Q1; Small/Illiquid long Q1 short Q5

testable_here: Partial: no market cap for the split; the micro-cap reversal side is mostly not listed as perps
note: Measures the past-return quintile spread separately in large liquid coins (expected continuation) and small illiquid coins (expected reversal) over the next week.

params.sign_by_group: liquid UMD positive, illiquid UMD negative

testable_here: Y: returns and Amihud from klines
note: Measures the 14-day winners-minus-losers spread within Amihud liquidity groups, expected positive in liquid coins and negative in illiquid ones.

params.source_detail: secondary news description; quantiles, weighting and universe not stated

testable_here: Y: klines; rule details beyond the horizons not stated
note: Measures whether the past-return spread is momentum at a 2-week sort and hold and turns to reversal from about 4 weeks.

params.score: ln(close of week t) - ln(highest intraday price over the past h weeks)
params.split: as S-XS-13: Large&Liquid = cap >= $50M and weekly volume >= $5M
params.sign_by_group: Large&Liquid long Q5 (nearest the high) short Q1; Small/Illiquid reverse

testable_here: Partial: intraday highs from klines, but no market cap for the split
note: Measures the spread between coins nearest and furthest from their h-week high over the next week, separately in large liquid and small illiquid coins.

params.factor: mean(high-value small, high-value big) - mean(low-value small, low-value big)

testable_here: Y: needs 52 weeks of listing and zombie-bar screening; size groups need a cap proxy
note: Measures whether coins with the worst past 52-week return beat those with the best over the next week.

params.measure: growth in addresses with a balance

testable_here: N: needs per-coin on-chain address data
note: Measures whether coins with the fastest growth in funded addresses beat those with the slowest over the next week.

testable_here: N: needs per-coin on-chain new-address data
note: Measures whether coins that are cheap relative to their count of new addresses beat expensive ones over the next week.
